crossRefs.note: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and…
and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.”
Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that…
They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

parallels.note: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.”
They answered, “ ‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen…

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.”
translations.bsb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
translations.kjv: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
translations.asv: And they told him, saying, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.
